name: postmark-mcp
description: Postmark (messaging): me, send, list_inbound. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_postmark_server_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN
platform_mcp_postmark_server_token.description: Postmark server API token, sent as the X-Postmark-Server-Token header ('requests that require server level privileges'; 401 'Missing or incorrect API token in header', https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview).

platform_mcp_postmark_sender.title: PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_SENDER
platform_mcp_postmark_sender.description: Sender address used as `From` on every send: 'Sender email address. Registered and confirmed Sender Signature is required' (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_SENDER.

platform_mcp_postmark_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_ENV
platform_mcp_postmark_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_postmark_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_postmark_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /server ('requires server level privileges') describes the server the token belongs to (ID, Name, DeliveryType, InboundAddress, ...).

tools.name: send
tools.description: `From` comes from the per-install `sender` config field; `to` may be a comma-separated list (max 50 recipients); `text` is sent as TextBody; `channel`, when given, is the MessageStream id. status is Postmark's `Message` ('OK'); 422 on invalid fields → isError.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: Inbound message search (`count` 'Number of messages to return per request. Max 500', `offset` 'Number of messages to skip'; status defaults to processed). The search list carries no body: `text` is unset (subject under raw.Subject; TextBody on GET /messages/inbound/{messageid}/details). `since` and `channel` are not sent.
